variants.note: no single HGVS form for this kind of alteration

entries.quote: EGFR mutations were found in additional lung cancer samples from U.S. patients who responded to gefitinib therapy
entries.cited_text: EGFR mutations were found in additional lung cancer samples from U.S. patients who responded to gefitinib therapy and in a lung adenocarcinoma cell line that was hypersensitive to growth inhibition by gefitinib, but not in gefitinib-insensitive tumors or cell lines.

checker.reason: The units state that EGFR mutations were found in patients and cell lines that responded to gefitinib, but not in those that were insensitive, linking the alteration to drug response.
